final: WITH j AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_volume, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total_volume, num_transactions, CAST(total_volume AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(total_volume) FROM j) AS share FROM j ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
